build_partition: build a Partition instance representing a subgraph with nodes, inputs, outputs, dependencies, and a graph for a split module
split_module_graph: split a torch.fx GraphModule into multiple submodules using a partition callback that maps nodes to partition identifiers
run_split_with_callback: run module splitting with a custom split_callback that assigns each node to a numeric partition for subgraph creation
split_with_grad_autocast_regions: split a GraphModule while preserving torch.amp autocast and torch._C._set_grad_enabled region boundaries across partitions
split_with_qualname_mapping: split a GraphModule and obtain a qualname_map dictionary mapping new submodule target names to original target names
